title: Derived reduction of integral complexes modulo powers of the uniformizer
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] (with $\ell\neq p$ as in [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]), a scheme $Y$ and an integer $n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$; put $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$. Let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_Y$ be the completed coefficient sheaf of rings on the small pro-etale site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$, with its projection $\pi_n:\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\twoheadrightarrow(A_{E,n})_Y$ and derived category $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$ of sheaves of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ be the derived category of sheaves of $(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)$, represented by a complex of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules, choose a K-flat resolution $P\to K$, i.e. a quasi-isomorphism from a K-flat complex $P$ of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] (one exists, even with flat terms and termwise surjective [lem-pc-kflat-resolution]), and define the *derived reduction modulo $\varpi_E^n$*

$$
 K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}:=P\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}(A_{E,n})_Y\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n}),
$$

the complex of $(A_{E,n})_Y$-modules obtained by applying the change of rings $-\otimes_{\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}}(A_{E,n})_Y$ along $\pi_n$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] termwise to $P$. By [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] (applied to the site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ and $\varphi=\pi_n$) this object is independent of the choice of $P$ up to canonical isomorphism in $D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$, and $K\mapsto K\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$ is the exact functor $L\pi_n^*:D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\mathcal O_E)\to D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ of that node, the derived pullback along the morphism of ringed sites $(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},(A_{E,n})_Y)\to(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y})$ given by the identity of the site and $\pi_n$.

split_report.summary: Checked the construction against Bhatt-Scholze Section 6.5 (p. 49, Definition 6.5.1 and Lemma 6.5.4) and Stacks sites-cohomology Tags 06YL/06YS/06YT/06YV/06YY. The statement restated K-flatness and cited Stacks for existence and independence without nodes: it now points to def-pc-kflat-complex (K-flat complexes and K-flat resolutions) and lem-pc-kflat-resolution (existence), and to a new general ringed-site statement lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings (quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes stay quasi-isomorphisms after termwise change of rings, Stacks 06YT; the derived change of rings is an everywhere defined left derived functor computed by K-flat resolutions, Stacks 06YY with 06XN), which carries the independence of the choice and the functoriality. Added def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension (A_{E,n}, O_E, uniformizer) to stmt_deps; the undefined 'l != p' now refers to def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients. lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings is not needed for the definition itself (it says the reduction of a flat-term K-flat P is again K-flat with flat terms, used by def-pur-integral-derived-operations). Source moved from the blueprint to Bhatt-Scholze p. 49 (the blueprint place kept inside source.place).
